title: X-M1 named film-recipe set v1
description: Host-authored RC1 recipe set for the official X-M1 1.50 firmware (reports/recipe-design.md). Values are ordinary-control choices from the owner-recorded menus. Firmware-side tokens (stored codes, addresses, label ids, table rows) are compiler output and are refused as instance keys; recipe.id is the author's own key. No layout fingerprint appears here by design: it is pinned in recipes/layout-fingerprint.txt and compared against the compiled layout module (clause C7). Length limits are measured rendering bounds (P6) whose width budget the validator checks; count limits are design ceilings, and the compiled check enforces the layout module's bound.

tier.description: RC1 named recipes reuse the five offered stock processing modes. A base mode outside them is RC0/RC2 and belongs in a different tier file.

recipes.description: Unique ids and the compiled index bound are checked by the Haskell validator (reports/recipe-design.md C2, C4); JSON Schema expresses neither. The ceiling of 31 comes from the five-bit C-slot copy of the recipe index; the live byte at settings-image 0x127 could hold more.

recipeName.description: ASCII letters, digits, space and ./+- only. Bound rendering ceiling (reports/recipe-design.md P6): FONT_LATIN.FDL covers every printable ASCII code, and twelve worst-case 'W' characters measure 328 px inside the 440 px name box. The validator checks the 14 667 per-mille advance budget alongside this cap.

helpLine.description: The film-simulation label entry has one help line; the same character set as the name plus , and '. Eighteen characters render under the draw path's code caps but can exceed the 400 px help box for near-all-W strings, so the validator checks the 13 333 per-mille advance budget alongside this cap (reports/recipe-design.md P6).

help.description: One help line, the film-simulation label entry's single help field.

whiteBalance.description: Mode only. The two-axis R/B shift is not representable in the payload (reports/recipe-design.md section 2, P13).

noise_reduction.description: Property 0xef, payload +0x10 bits 5-7. -2 is LOW, +2 is HIGH.

iso.description: The 1.50 offered set. AUTO is stored code 0x00; the menu's second AUTO row (0x1b) is not modelled.
